description: Search a project's own Jira (see get_linked_jira_issue) with JQL, as its own search does — e.g. 'project = ACME AND status != Done ORDER BY updated DESC', 'text ~ "login"'; currentUser() is the project token's owner, not you. Answers each issue's jira_key, jira_url, summary, type, status, priority, assignee and when it changed; read one whole with get_linked_jira_issue. A query the site cannot read comes back with its reason. This is the other site's JQL; this tracker's own issues are searched with search_issues. Name the project by 'project', or an issue here by 'issue'. For the people who work in the project; at most 10 reads of the linked Jira a minute per person.

issue.description: An issue here, e.g. 'PM-12', whose project's Jira is searched.

jql.description: The JQL query, as that Jira reads it.

limit.description: How many issues, at most 30. Default 10.

project.description: Project key here, e.g. 'PM'. Or give 'issue'.

name: search_linked_jira
